proposals.name: Kavra Morn
proposals.entry:
Kavra Morn is the present ruler of the Gravoska Kingdom. She is an older Gravosk woman, immense even among her own people, with a broken horn and heavy streaks of gray running through her shaggy hair.

Several of Kavra’s children have died during the 99 War. She rarely speaks about them publicly and never invokes their deaths while demanding sacrifices from other families.

Her political reputation rests less upon charisma than upon an almost frightening willingness to accept consequences. Kavra does not claim that Gravosk victory is inevitable. She claims that Gravosk will continue.

As First Witness, she presides over disputes involving ancient law, national obligation and the crown itself. She has publicly lost legal arguments. She has also carried out judgments against her own supporters after ruling against them. Gravosk respect this enormously.

posts.name: Gamemaster Only
posts.entry:
Kavra’s own accession depends upon a wartime judgment that was never formally completed. The missing Witness who could reopen the case has recently returned.

Kavra knows exactly where he is. She has made no attempt to silence him.
